answer_1.quote: In this work, we build a summarization system that compresses text in a more data-driven way... We evaluate our approach on several summarization benchmarks.

answer_2.quote: We benchmark our system first with an automatic evaluation based on ROUGE-1/2/L F1.

answer_4.quote: Specifically, we run the plausibility model on 50 summaries from each of CNN and Reddit, and have annotators judge whether the predicted plausible compressions are grammatical and factual with respect to the original sentence.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged if deleting a span negatively impacts grammaticality and factuality.
